question: What has been told to the addressee regarding the practice of the soul?
premises: That something is the practice of the soul.
It has been told to the addressee.
The address is made to Bhairavī.
inference: This practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
uncertainties: Full content of the practice not repeated here
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
